name: Make opening a Story after creation configurable
description:
## Problem
Creating a Story in the TUI currently opens the new Story automatically. Users should be able to choose whether to open it or return to the Board or list they were using.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add an "Open Story after creation" toggle in Settings.
- The toggle is off by default, including when no preference has been saved.
- When off, successfully creating a Story returns to the originating Board or list, with the new Story saved and the view refreshed.
- When on, successfully creating a Story opens the newly created Story, preserving the current behavior.
- The preference persists across TUI restarts and can be turned on or off again in Settings.
- The setting applies consistently when creating a Story from either a Board or a list.
- Update the user guide to describe the setting and its default.

## Verification
Create a Story from both Board and list views with the toggle off and on. Confirm the destination after saving, then restart the TUI and confirm the saved preference still applies.
